question.text: The equivalent conductance of monobasic acid at infinite dilution is 348 <math><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">q</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> . If the resistivity of the solution containing 15 g acid (mol. wt 49) in litre is 18.5 ohm cm. What is the % degree of dissociation of acid? Report your answer up to two decimal places without rounding up.
